correctness.rationale: The actual pinned RESULT.md identifies concepts with maximal independent vertex sets of the missing-incidence bipartite graph; disconnected factors form direct-product lattices. Its constructive P6 extents witness N5. An independent standard-library Prüfer enumeration examined all labelled trees of orders 2..6: 1,3,16,125,1296, respectively; exactly the 360 six-vertex paths are nondistributive, none smaller. At q=t n^(-6/5), expected connected seven-vertex subtrees and short cycles vanish as O(n^(-1/5)); the dependency-graph overlap estimate O(sum_{h=1}^4 n^(11-h)q^(10-h)) yields total-variation Poisson(alpha^3 t^5) with O(n^(-1/5)) error. Subcritical Markov and supercritical second-moment plus isolation (nq->0) yield both limits. Finite tree enumeration is used only for the exact small-obstruction lemma, not the infinite stochastic limit.
residual_risks: Independent tree census covers orders 2..6; rare-event and supercritical asymptotics rely on stated overlap counting and standard Stein–Chen/second-moment methods rather than numerical simulation.
Only independent Bernoulli incidences, m/n->positive alpha, and q=o(1/n) are covered.
